<!-- pr-reviewer: 12a0193d678625a4c4d56f71296d73af3d350375 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is the second review of the safety floor. The dispatcher asked for an independent check of the claims in the first safety-tier review on this head.

What looks good:
- The material reader gives setup-frame facets and bounds. See `crates/app/src/operation/material.rs:231`. `named_material` calls `setup_align::facets_in` and `setup_align::entity_aabb_in`. A selection source unions the same reader. See `crates/app/src/operation/material.rs:77`.
- The height reader gives setup-frame model bounds. See `crates/app/src/operation/heights.rs:68`. `TopOfModel` and `BottomOfModel` call `setup_align::part_aabb_in`.
- The Deburr kernel does not read the world. See `crates/motion/src/finishing3d/deburr.rs:133`. Its signature takes owned facets and parameters. `camcraft-motion` has no ECS dependency, so a world read cannot exist there. The call site passes `material.facets`. See `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs:1173`.
- Part-protection reads use `setup_align::facets_in` and `setup_align::parts_facets_in`. See `crates/app/src/operation/frame.rs:107` and `frame.rs:125`.
- The new tests pin the frame by shape, not only by comparison. Each cut point must sit on the turned top rim (Z 14, X [10, 20], Y [-5, 5]). A model-frame read fails that assert without a mutation. The turned-versus-baked equality pins both the path and the posted program. The modelled part must differ or refuse.
- The three refusal sentinels moved from Deburr to Probe. Probe stays unverified. The updated refusal-message assert names Deburr.
- The allowlist entry and the message change are the whole source delta. No UI, golden, dependency, build script or process file changed.

Results, merged with main (`a8bb30f0c`) locally in a review worktree:
- Trial merge: clean, no conflicts.
- Quick gate (`cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main`): all 15 steps passed. 453 passed, 1 ignored, 0 failed. Suites: app lib, fixture_locate_stock, heights_fixtures, opframe_picks, opframe_seam, setup_align, setup_align_2d_area, setup_align_2d_kinds, setup_align_3d, setup_align_chamfer, setup_align_deburr, setup_align_hole_kinds, setup_carry, stock_source_verdict.
- `setup_align_deburr`: 2 passed. Both new proof tests pass.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

Requested before merge: none.

Notes, not blocking:
- I did not repeat the two reader mutations that the first review ran. The rim-position asserts make the pinning test fail on a model-frame read by design, so I verified that by reading the test.
- `crates/app/src/setup_align.rs` is 412 lines. It was already over 400; this PR adds three net lines. Consider a split later.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
